messages:
Maria L: heads up — we need a low-friction path to soft-deprecate v1 per-route without blowing up tenant quotas. thinking: per-route `soft_deprec_flag` + opt-in pinning for 90-day grace. @Kevin T any concerns about routing complexity?
Kevin T: i like per-route flag. main risk is telemetry/attribution. if we shadow v2 for traffic but still bill v1, metrics will diverge. need clear metric names and dashboard split.
Ashok R: agree. propose: increment `routing.deprecation.shadow_requests` for shadowed hits and `routing.deprecation.active_requests` for routed ones. keep token-based billing the canonical source but expose a "billing_delta" time series.
Nina P: console UX note — tenants will freak if they see a banner that says "v1 deprecated" with no rollout context. suggest banner copy: "This route is scheduled for soft-deprecation. Try v2 in a preview cohort (0-100%)" + quick link to toggle opt-in.
Julie S: toggle must be per-route + per-tenant. ops needs an emergency escape hatch to force-route back to v1 for safety. also need audit log entries when toggles change.
Maria L: implementation sketch: router checks header `X-Redwood-Version` then `route.soft_deprec_flag`. if header absent and soft_deprec_flag on -> shadow probed sample to v2 but keep primary on v1. sample config stored in route config: `shadow_weight_pct`.
Kevin T: can we avoid sticky routing for shadow probe? we want representative samples across sessions. prefer non-sticky sampling for first-pass, then sticky if customer opts in.
Ashok R: telemetry detail — tag spans with `deprecation_cohort: control|shadow|optin`. that ties into traces and error budgets. add counters: `deprecation.latency.delta_ms` (p95) and `deprecation.output_regression_rate` (count).
Nina P: dashboard asks: we need a pre-built panel in console with: cohort distribution, p95 latency delta, top failing prompts (by evaluation set), and billing delta estimate. can we auto-create when a route flips soft_deprec_flag?
Julie S: yes, but throttle creation for customers with >1000 routes. create a sample dashboard pointing to a `route_id` template variable.
console-bot: NOTE: when soft_deprec_flag is enabled for a route, a banner will be issued to owners and a daily summary will be sent to the route admins (first 7 days).
ops-bot: ALERT: if `deprecation.output_regression_rate` > 3% for 30m or `billing_delta` > 20% continuous for 1h, we auto-roll back shadowing and open an incident.
Maria L: open questions: 1) Should shadow requests count toward tenant rate limits? 2) How do we represent quota usage in billing preview?
Kevin T: my vote: do not count shadows against hard quotas. but include them in a separate quota-like estimate so tenants can preview cost. if they opt-in to route-level pinning then real requests move and are billed normally.
Ashok R: implementation note: metric keys and tag names must be stable before GA. propose RFC PR with full metric list. also PR for the router to support `shadow_weight_pct` and `cohort_tag`.
Nina P: UX follow-up: design a small modal to explain "soft deprecation" when owners click the banner — show sample telemetry, expected impact, and an "opt into preview" CTA.
Julie S: assignments: Ashok to draft metrics RFC, Kevin to prototype router sampling logic, Nina to mock modal text, Maria to write runbook for rollback triggers.
Maria L: ok i'll create tickets and a short timeline. aim for alpha in 2 weeks behind console flag. :thumbsup:
Kevin T: quick code snippet idea for router check:```python
if header == 'v2' or route.pinned_to_v2:
    route_to(v2)
elif route.soft_deprec_flag:
    if random() < route.shadow_weight_pct/100:
        shadow_probe(v2)
    route_to(v1)
else:
    route_to(v1)
```
Ashok R: perfect. add logging: `deprecation_cohort` with values (control, shadow, optin) on every request.
Nina P: we should also surface a small "confidence" ticker (0-100) based on eval regression signals. tiny green/red dot next to banner.
Maria L: agreed. thanks everyone — i'll post the ticket links and RFC PRs in this thread when ready.
Kevin T: thanks — will review router PR early next week.
Julie S: noted for runbook review.
Maria L: end.
